correctness.rationale: Support widths reduce to a single cosine arc modulo cell length 2q_n (q_n=pi/n even and pi/(2n) odd; odd amplitude 2R cos q_n). Direct overlap integration gives C_q(r)=((2q-r)cos r+r cos(2q-r)+sin(2q-r)+sin r)/(4q). Its derivative equals r(2q-r)[sinc(2q-r)-sinc r]/(4q)<0 for r in (0,q), sinc decreasing on (0,pi). Centered periodic autocovariance has zero full-period integral and hence negative minimum. Uniform cosine Taylor series and Var(cos qU)=q^4/45-q^6/315+O(q^8) give deterministic uniform O(q^2) coupling. Independent SymPy series returned lag coefficient -(15 z^4-60 z^3+60 z^2-8)/360 (equals 1/45-z^2(2-z)^2/24). This verifies the quartic correlation; marginal endpoints and skewness follow from E[U^{2j}]=1/(2j+1). The whole-process statement uses a common angle, not independent directions.
